findings.issue: The deprecated aliases re-expose `SmoothEmbedding.AmbientIsotopic` and its companion namespace API, preserving the misleading public name this PR is meant to remove.

summary: The new `ContinuousAmbientIsotopic` API is appropriately named, but the PR keeps the old smooth-sounding API as public deprecated aliases, so the misleading surface remains available to downstream users.
